boards.name: Bullhorn
boards.notes: About page says Bullhorn is founder-led and headquartered in Boston; no country or parent company is named. Pricing page lists $99/user/month and $165/user/month. The API docs link on bullhorn.com points to a bullhorn.github.io address. Ingest is via a marketplace of pre-integrated partners. Language menu lists regions, not languages.

sources.title: Integrate with Bullhorn
sources.quote: third-party providers must contract directly with Bullhorn for API and platform access

sources.title: Homepage marketplace section
sources.quote: Bullhorn’s marketplace of 300+ pre-integrated technology partners gives staffing agencies the tools

boards.name: Tracker
boards.notes: Plans page lists a $99 /user/month Core plan billed monthly, with a 6-month minimum term. REST API access is listed as a plan feature, but no developer page or key process was found. Job posting to job boards is offered from within Tracker. No headquarters, parent company or language options were stated.

sources.title: ATS integrations
sources.quote: Post jobs to 7,000+ job boards in 100 countries from Tracker

boards.name: Atlas
boards.notes: Pricing page lists £105 and £135 per user / month on a 12-month commitment, with a 14-day free start. API keys are created by the agency in the dashboard, per the API reference. Job posting to multiple boards is offered from the Atlas portal. No headquarters, parent company, language options or partner program were stated.

sources.title: Pricing
sources.quote: Every Atlas plan runs on a 12-month commitment.

sources.title: Atlas API Reference
sources.quote: API keys are generated from the Atlas dashboard.

sources.title: Atlas API Reference
sources.quote: Go to Settings → Developers → API keys and create a new key.

sources.title: Integrations
sources.quote: Post your jobs to multiple job boards and process applicants directly in your portal.

boards.name: TempWorks Software
boards.notes: Footer address is Bloomington, MN 55437, with no country named. No pricing or subscription terms were found; the site offers request-a-demo. The integration partners page lists a Job Boards & Distribution category. No developer or API page was linked from the pages read.

sources.title: Recruitment experience ATS
sources.quote: Create customized job boards that connect to your ATS for simplified hiring and onboarding

boards.name: Clockwork Recruiting
boards.notes: Partners page invites integration builders to contact the company to learn about its partnerships program, API documentation and integration process. Platform pricing page states only 'One plan. All the features.' with no prices. No headquarters, parent company or language options were stated.

sources.title: Partners and integrations
sources.quote: If you are interested in becoming a Clockwork Partner or building an integration with Clockwork

sources.title: Partners and integrations
sources.quote: learn more about our partnerships program, API documentation and integration process
